_help: Generated by tools/theme_arcade_painted.py — do not edit by hand. Magnet Mayhem's UiTheme variation name → the gohud_arcade_light variation that carries exactly its items and values. The game builds its theme as duplicate(arcade_light) plus these names as aliases. game_only lists the game's variations that stay in the game (why in _game_only_why).

_font._help: The theme's default_font is the game's UiTheme.get_font(): a FontVariation of base font + fallbacks (the game reorders the fallbacks per language itself).

_font_sizes._help: Only the default font is written; no variation has a font of its own. The font sizes written are the game's literal ones or a Cfg size's desktop value (named in _cfg_sizes).

_cfg_sizes._help: Values that are a Cfg size in the game, written at their desktop value; where Cfg has a touch value (named per entry) the game swaps it in itself.

_code_built._help: gohud variations the game builds in code rather than as a UiTheme variation: gohud variation → where the game builds it.

_base_types._help: Base types this shape styles as the game does (the game pins base types itself).
